description: Implementation of a simple field expression used in query filtering, sorting, and existence checks within the Eclipse Ditto framework. Contains methods for accepting visitors, equality, hash code, and string representation.

classes.name: SimpleFieldExpressionImpl
classes.description: Represents a simple field expression used in query filtering, sorting, and existence checks.

methods.name: SimpleFieldExpressionImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the simple field expression with a field name.

methods.name: acceptFilterVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a filter field expression visitor.

methods.name: acceptExistsVisitor
methods.description: Accepts an existence field expression visitor.

methods.name: acceptSortVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a sort field expression visitor.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a generic field expression visitor.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the field name of the expression.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the field name.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on the class type and field name.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the simple field expression.
